scope: Estimated allocated GPU hours per full TRAIN epoch; excludes calendar queue time
train_seconds_formula: 11104772 / measured training rps including loader and gradient diagnostics
initialization_and_close_seconds_formula: max(0,actual parent ElapsedRaw - train seconds - all evaluation seconds - ALL checkpoint save/readback seconds)
revision_reason: The v3 workflow measures all nine checkpoint save/readbacks. Subtract all of these from initialization to prevent double-counting earlier saves as repeated startup; no measured final scores were available when declaring this revision.
limitations: Sample throughput and linear validation scaling are estimates. Report each seed, actual GPU model, and hardware-matched A0 throughput and VRAM comparisons. Full-data locality may differ.
